findings.description: Choosing a sort order (Name Z to A, Price low to high, Price high to low) does not re-order the product list; it always stays in Name A to Z order and the dropdown snaps back to Name (A to Z).
repro: Sign in as customer
On /inventory.html choose Price (low to high) in the sort dropdown
List remains Backpack, Bike Light, Bolt T-Shirt... (A to Z) and dropdown shows Name (A to Z)

findings.description: The Remove button on the product list does nothing: the button stays 'Remove' and the cart badge count does not decrease.
repro: Sign in as customer
Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light (badge 2)
Click Remove on Bike Light
Button remains Remove and badge still shows 2

findings.description: On a product's detail page the Remove button does nothing: after Add to cart turns into Remove, clicking Remove leaves the button and the cart badge unchanged.
repro: Sign in as customer
Open /inventory-item.html?id=4
Click Add to cart (button becomes Remove, badge 1)
Click Remove: button stays Remove, badge stays 1

findings.description: Add to cart silently does nothing for Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt, Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket and Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red), on both the list and their detail pages (ids 1, 5, 3): no Remove button, no badge, item never reaches the cart. Backpack, Bike Light and Onesie add fine.
repro: Sign in as customer
On /inventory.html click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket
Button stays Add to cart and no cart badge appears; same on /inventory-item.html?id=5

findings.description: The product detail page does not show the product description (list page does); only name, price and button are shown, and the console logs 'This component failed to render!' on each detail page.
repro: Sign in as customer
Open /inventory-item.html?id=4
Compare with list: the description paragraph is missing

findings.description: Finish on the checkout overview does nothing: the user stays on the overview, no confirmation page, cart is not emptied. Console shows a JS error 'cesetRart is not a function'.
repro: Sign in as customer, add Backpack and Onesie
Cart > Checkout, fill First Name, Last Name, Zip, Continue
Click Finish: page stays at /checkout-step-two.html and badge remains

notes: Untested: responsive layout, accessibility audit in depth.
